photos in object storage bucket

voice notes in object storage bucket

transcripts stored text

default everything private to couple

public link only serves public_payload_json (never raw drops)

Voice → transcript (Whisper/Deepgram)

“Vibe line” generator for share card (safe prompt, no specifics)

Guardrails:

Never infer cheating

Never recommend breakups

Never read external texts/messages unless explicitly integrated later

Week 1

Auth + couple pairing

New Drop (photo + 3 words + optional voice)

Feed + notifications

Nominate/Approve flow

Highlight viewer

Week 2

Weekly Chapter generator (simple)

Drift snapshot + 1 nudge template

Share link card MVP

Basic analytics events

Key metrics:

Drops per couple per week

Nomination rate

Approval rate

Week-2 retention

Share link creation rate
